old_caption: The video showcases two colorful fidget spinners spinning on a plain white surface. The first spinner is positioned slightly out of focus in the background, while the second spinner is in sharp focus in the foreground. Both spinners exhibit a vibrant rainbow-like iridescence, reflecting light in various colors such as purple, blue, green, and yellow. The central bearing of each spinner is gold-colored, providing a striking contrast to the metallic, reflective arms. As the video progresses, both spinners continue their rapid rotation, creating a mesmerizing blur effect due to their speed. The camera remains stationary throughout, maintaining a consistent angle that captures the dynamic motion of the spinning spinners against the stark white background. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, allowing the viewer to focus solely on the intricate details and movement of the fidget spinners.

caption: The video showcases two three-lobed fidget spinners with anodized rainbow-colored bodies and gold central bearing caps resting on a flat light-gray surface. One spinner sits slightly out of focus in the upper-left background while the other, sharper, occupies the lower-right foreground. Both are already turning about their central axes when the clip opens and continue to rotate throughout, their three lobes sweeping through changing angular orientations. The gold hubs remain fixed at the center of each spinner while the lobes blur with sustained rotational speed. As the metal surfaces turn relative to the light, iridescent patches of green, blue, purple and yellow shift position and hue across each lobe. The centers of the spinners hold their places on the surface, so the visible change is the rotation of the objects rather than any translation across the scene. The background spinner mirrors this motion, its own lobes reorienting in the same continuous manner.
